newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch father admits killing children, police say.
newsitem.headline: Dutch father admits killing children, police say.

text.p: A Dutch father arrested on suspicion of murdering his three children has told police that he and his wife killed them, police said on Thursday.
"The father indicated that he and his wife were responsible for the death of the children," police said in a statement.
The couple, both aged 36, were both in hospital with serious stab wounds and the mother was not yet well enough to be interviewed, the statement added.

They were arrested late on Wednesday after police summoned to the family home in Hoofddorp near Amsterdam by concerned friends found the bodies of the three children -- a girl aged seven and boys of eight and nine -- in a bedroom.
It was not immediately revealed how the children had died, but an unsigned note found at the scene linked their deaths to the death from leukaemia of their eldest brother two years ago.
